description: Write a ready-to-query .cuemap package for one project to a local file. The package contains sensitive project content; use only after the user explicitly approves the exact output path.

confirmed.description: Must be true after explicit user approval of the output path and any overwrite.

output_path.description: Absolute local path for the .cuemap file.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default is false.

project.description: Project ID to package. Defaults to the repository-scoped project.

name: cuemap_project_pack
